head: 4f7f59718e29240225ab65a3f6d3ab6915e97057
summary: The runner's deferred build/test/lint targets run code the session just wrote outside the sandbox, with no network allow-list, as the same user as the parent run_phase.py process whose own environment holds the App token (as GITHUB_TOKEN), the workflow token and the model credential; commands_env strips them only from the child's environment, so a session-written test can read them from /proc/<ancestor pid>/environ and exfiltrate them or push with the App identity.
